subject: Film & Cinema
title: John Ford: Painter of the American West
description: A 60-second lesson on John Ford: Painter of the American West.

hook.text: John Ford pointed his camera at Monument Valley and invented America's visual mythology.

buildup.text: His Westerns — Stagecoach, The Searchers — defined a genre and a national self-image.

discovery.text: Ford's genius was composition — every shot was a painting that told a story on its own.

twist.text: His films romanticized settlers while marginalizing Native Americans — a legacy now re-examined.

climax.text: Ford won four Best Director Oscars, a record that still stands.

punchline.text: He built a myth and a problem in the same frame.

quiz.question: How many Best Director Oscars did John Ford win?
